description: This file contains core initialization and loader functions for the Enyo JavaScript framework, including platform-specific security functions, resource loading (CSS and JS), dependency management, and path configuration.

methods.name: enyo.execUnsafeLocalFunction
methods.description: Executes a function with platform-specific security restrictions, using MSApp on Windows 8 if available.

methods.name: enyo.machine.sheet
methods.description: Loads a CSS or Less stylesheet into the document, handling different loading methods based on runtime state.

methods.name: enyo.machine.script
methods.description: Dynamically loads a JavaScript file, either via document.write or by creating a script element.

methods.name: enyo.machine.inject
methods.description: Injects JavaScript code directly into the document.

methods.name: enyo.depends
methods.description: Loads dependencies such as scripts or stylesheets based on provided arguments.

methods.name: enyo.load
methods.description: Queues and manages runtime loading of dependencies, supporting sequential loading with callbacks.

methods.name: enyo.path.addPaths
methods.description: Adds path aliases for resource loading.
